assessment.planImpact: Refreshes candidate availability and capability boundaries only. Cadaclysm 0.10.0 is a proprietary SAT/B-rep route with no published SAB claim; Ansys 2026 R1 documents a proprietary standalone SAT/SAB route through ACIS versions up to 2023. New generic open-source B-rep kernels do not document ACIS import, and CADKernel's detailed ACIS matrix marks it planned/unsupported. All remain non-promoting until exact-profile results exist. Any result must be separated into carrier extraction/AcDs identity, semantic interpretation, and native application acceptance.

implementationReadyChecks: Do not add either proprietary package/product to local fast tests or implementation dependencies.
Check only already-available lawful installation/evaluation eligibility at the composed checkpoint; if unavailable, record NOT_AVAILABLE and continue.
Use exact pinned package/source/product identity and hashes, and require the payload's actual inner ACIS profile to be within the candidate's documented scope.
Do not count generic B-rep-kernel capability as ACIS read support unless a pinned source revision provides a SAT/SAB decoder route.
Generate controls from scratch in temporary storage or use already-in-repository fixtures; do not download or commit third-party DWG/DXF test fixtures.
Use independent analytic expectations, body validity and per-entity/body dispositions; a successful open, rendered mesh, or same-codec roundtrip alone is insufficient.
Keep SAT-only evidence separate from SAB and from DWG AcDs section/key/owner association; keep native FreeCAD qualification separate.
Candidate research and availability cannot promote support claims or change J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, or J295 from DEFERRED_EXTERNAL.
